name: mini-trello
description: Mini Trello — collaborative Kanban board (Next.js, Express, Socket.IO, MongoDB)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @mini-trello/backend" "npm run dev -w @mini-trello/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mini-trello/backend && npm run build -w @mini-trello/frontend
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
